description:
Use this when the user wants a community preset for themselves: "add that preset", "I want the Hype one".
Copies it into the user's own templates (adding twice finds the first copy); a Premium preset is added too,
but a free plan cannot export it. Returns the template name style_clip takes.
Not for: putting a look on a clip (style_clip) or sharing the user's own preset (done in RipClip). Costs no
Horizon Units.
name: add_preset
title: Add a community preset
